content.text:
Agent Braid found one conflict. `docs-guide` and `guide-and-api` both modify `docs/guide.md`, so they can't both run freely in parallel. `src-cli` is independent of the other two.

| Branch | Files changed (against `main`) |
|---|---|
| `docs-guide` | `docs/guide.md` |
| `guide-and-api` | `docs/guide.md`, `src/api.py` |
| `src-cli` | `src/cli.py` |

| Pair | Result | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `docs-guide` and `guide-and-api` | **Conflicting** | Both modify `docs/guide.md`. Agent Braid says to serialize them or isolate them. |
| `docs-guide` and `src-cli` | Independent candidate | The files they change don't overlap. |
| `guide-and-api` and `src-cli` | Independent candidate | The files they change don't overlap. |

- **What this means for your constraint:** No branch needs to wait for another, but `docs-guide` and `guide-and-api` will probably have a merge conflict in `docs/guide.md`. Whichever one merges second has to resolve it. If you want to avoid that, split the `guide.md` edits out of one branch.
- **Limits of the check:** It compares the exact files each branch changes, and it doesn't read the edits themselves. "Independent candidate" means the files don't overlap. It doesn't prove the branches are safe to run in parallel. It also can't see semantic dependencies. For example, a change to `src/api.py` might affect `src/cli.py` without any shared file.
- **Authority:** This was read-only analysis. No execution was authorized and nothing was run.

The evidence reference is `ev-77b4c7cf56bd436581289bfb4e1ddd3e`.
